question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

The dacoits __ravaged__ the bungalow in the absence of its owner.
solution:
The correct answer is **Restored.**** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ **

__
 
• **“Ravaged” means to destroy something.**
 
• “**Restore**” means **to bring back something to its previous situation after its destruction**.
 
 
• **Example**: *The building took almost three years to be restored*.
 
 
 
• Therefore, “**Restored** (पुनः स्थापित करना)**” **is the correct antonym for “**Ravaged** (तबाह)**”**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**The meaning and usage of the other words are as follows:

 
• “**Exploded **(विस्फोट)” means "**bursted".**

 
 
• **Example**: *Without any warning, the light bulb suddenly exploded with a deafening sound.*
 
 
 
• “**Demolished **(ध्वस्त)**”** means **destroyed.**
 
 
• **Example:** *Many roadside soaps were demolished by the government as they were illegally built.*
 
 
 
• “**Sealed** (मोहरबंद)” means **to close something securely.**
 
 
• **Example**: *He sealed the letter with his own personal stamp and handed over it to the post man.*
